item.tib: mkha' 'gro dgongs pa 'dus pa las gshed 'dur klog zhags thog dbal
item.coloph: ces gshed 'dur klog zhags thog dbal 'di ni/ gsang 'dus gshen gyi mdzad srol/ bla chen yab sras kyi thugs bcud/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i dgongs pa/ sri gshed 'dur gyi phyag cha/ 'od ldan 'bar ma'i gsang lung / dus mtha'i rnam 'byor mu la bdag gis sa khyi hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes lnga'i tho rangs su/ mtshan ldan bu mo rin chen rus pa'i brgyan gyis spras pa zhig dal gyis byung ste/ yi ge dar sna lnga yi dril ba g+ha ('ga') bdag la byin byung ba/ rang nyams ci yin dran tshe/ 'di ni gsang sngags bla med kyi bon g+ha ('ga') yod pa gsang bdag 'ja' tshon snying po'i bon skal gyi 'phro yin pas khyod rang gi btang bzhag 'di tshod zin par gyis shig gsungs nas lung dang dbang sogs gnang byung ba'i snang tshul ltar ro/ de yi nang du phyi nang gsang ba'i bon 'ga' 'dug kyang bdag rtsol ba zhan pa'i (pas) le lo'i dbang du song ngo / drag gcod dang gnad gdams 'di gnyis sngon du shog thog phab pa'o/ gshed 'dur dang las byang gnyis 'di ni mi lo bcu gnyis la lus song yang / chu byi lo la rtse drug bla ma g.yung drung rin po che'i bka' yis bskul ba dang / slar mos pa can 'ga' yis zhu ba la brten nas/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma tshogs la gsol ba yang yang btab te/ brjed ngal (nges) kyi dbang du song ba srid na/ mthol bshags kyi sgo nas chu khyi hor zla pa'i tshes 8 la bkod pa dge legs su gyur cig/
